# Observers and model hooks

<!-- generated:examples:observers -->

??? example "Custom observable events"

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Observers\OrderObserver;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    #[ObservedBy(OrderObserver::class)]
    class Order extends Model
    {
        protected $observables = ['archived', 'shipped'];
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/OrderObserver.php"
    namespace App\Observers;

    use App\Events\OrderShipped;

    class OrderObserver // → observers.hooks ["archived","created"] → model_events[eloquent.archived: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method archived
    {
        public function archived(): void
        {
            event(new OrderShipped); // → observers[OrderObserver].dispatches.target OrderShipped
        }

        public function created(): void {}

        public function refunded(): void {} // ✗ not recorded
    }
    ```

??? example "eloquent.* event strings"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Listeners\AuditOrder;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $listen = [
            'eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order' => [
                AuditOrder::class, // → model_events[eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler AuditOrder
            ],
        ];

        public function boot(): void
        {
            Event::listen('eloquent.created: App\Models\Order', 'App\Listeners\AuditOrder@created'); // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method created
            Event::listen('eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order', [AuditOrder::class, 'updated']); // → model_events[eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method updated
            Event::listen('eloquent.booted: App\Models\Order', AuditOrder::class); // → model_events[eloquent.booted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler AuditOrder
            Event::listen('eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order', fn ($order) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure}
            $this->app['events']->listen('eloquent.restored: App\Models\Order', AuditOrder::class); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Listeners/AuditOrder.php"
    namespace App\Listeners;

    class AuditOrder
    {
        public function handle(): void {}

        public function created(): void {}

        public function updated(): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Observers\OrderObserver;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/BaseObserver.php"
    namespace App\Observers;

    abstract class BaseObserver
    {
        public function deleted(): void {} // → observers[OrderObserver].hooks deleted
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/TracksRestores.php"
    namespace App\Observers;

    trait TracksRestores
    {
        public function restored(): void {} // → observers[OrderObserver].hooks restored
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/OrderObserver.php"
    namespace App\Observers;

    class OrderObserver extends BaseObserver // → observers.hooks ["created","deleted","restored","trashed"]
    {
        use TracksRestores;

        protected function created(): void {} // → observers[OrderObserver].hooks created

        public function trashed(): void {} // → observers[OrderObserver].hooks trashed

        public function booted(): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "Model hook registrations"

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Events\OrderPlaced;
    use App\Support\OrderHooks;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class Order extends Model
    {
        protected static function booted(): void
        {
            static::created(function (Order $order) { // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure} → closure_listeners.registration model_hook
                event(new OrderPlaced); // → closure_listeners[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].dispatches.target OrderPlaced
            });
            static::saved([OrderHooks::class, 'saved']); // → model_events[eloquent.saved: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler OrderHooks
            static::deleted(OrderHooks::class); // → model_events[eloquent.deleted: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method handle
            static::updated('App\Support\OrderHooks@updated'); // → model_events[eloquent.updated: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method updated
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/Concerns/HasUuid.php"
    namespace App\Models\Concerns;

    trait HasUuid
    {
        protected static function bootHasUuid(): void
        {
            static::creating(fn ($model) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.creating: App\Models\User].handled_by.method {closure} → model_events[eloquent.creating: App\Models\Invoice].handled_by.method {closure}
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/User.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Models\Concerns\HasUuid;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class User extends Model
    {
        use HasUuid;
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/Invoice.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Models\Concerns\HasUuid;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class Invoice extends Model
    {
        use HasUuid;

        protected static function boot(): void
        {
            parent::boot();

            $callback = fn () => null;
            static::deleting($callback); // ✗ unreadable_model_hook
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Models\Order;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(\Closure $callback): void
        {
            Order::restored(fn (Order $order) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.restored: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure}
            Order::retrieved($callback); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Support/OrderHooks.php"
    namespace App\Support;

    class OrderHooks
    {
        public function saved(): void {}

        public function handle(): void {}

        public function updated(): void {}
    }
    ```

??? example "The $observers array"

    ```php title="app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Models\Order;
    use App\Models\User;
    use App\Observers\AuditObserver;
    use App\Observers\OrderObserver;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Providers\EventServiceProvider as ServiceProvider;

    class EventServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        protected $observers = [
            Order::class => [OrderObserver::class, AuditObserver::class], // → observers[OrderObserver].registration observers_array → observers[AuditObserver].observes App\Models\Order
            'App\Models\User' => AuditObserver::class, // → observers[AuditObserver].observes App\Models\User
        ];
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/OrderObserver.php"
    namespace App\Observers;

    class OrderObserver // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.handler OrderObserver
    {
        public function created(): void {}
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Observers/AuditObserver.php"
    {
    ```

??? example "A model's own static hook method"

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    class Order extends Model
    {
        public static function creating($callback): void {}

        protected static function booted(): void
        {
            static::creating(fn (Order $order) => null); // ✗ not recorded
            static::created(fn (Order $order) => null); // → model_events[eloquent.created: App\Models\Order].handled_by.method {closure}
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Models\Order;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(): void
        {
            Order::creating(fn (Order $order) => null); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Observer registrations"

    ```php title="app/Models/Order.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Observers\AuditObserver;
    use App\Observers\OrderObserver;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    #[ObservedBy(OrderObserver::class)] // → observers[OrderObserver].registration attribute
    class Order extends Model
    {
        protected static function booted(): void
        {
            static::observe(AuditObserver::class); // → observers[AuditObserver].registration observe_call
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Models/Invoice.php"
    namespace App\Models;

    use App\Observers\AuditObserver;
    use App\Observers\InvoiceObserver;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
    use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

    #[ObservedBy([InvoiceObserver::class])] // → observers[InvoiceObserver].observes App\Models\Invoice
    class Invoice extends Model
    {
        protected static function booted(): void
        {
            self::observe(AuditObserver::class); // → observers[AuditObserver].observes App\Models\Invoice
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php"
    namespace App\Providers;

    use App\Models\User;
    use App\Observers\UserObserver;
    use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

    class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
    {
        public function boot(string $observer): void
        {
            User::observe(UserObserver::class); // → observers[UserObserver].observes App\Models\User
            User::observe($observer); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```
